extDescription.message: Saves only what you can see right now as a single HTML file.

cmdCapture.message: Save the visible screen as HTML

cannotCapture.message: This page can't be saved (it's a browser screen)

needReload.message: Reload the page, then open this again

modeCropDesc.message: Opens to exactly what you're looking at right now

modeFullDesc.message: Keeps the full height, but empties whatever was off-screen

noticeDesc.message: If you save it as-is, the area behind the dialog comes out blank.

noticeToggle.message: Remove it and save what's underneath

noticeOnDesc.message: Saving now captures the page without it.

optFreezeDesc.message: Cuts every link, button and input, and leaves no scripts behind. Clicking does nothing

optOverlayDesc.message: Takes away pop-ups and banners, and saves what was underneath

optOcclusionDesc.message: Also removes text that was hidden behind dialogs or banners

optImagesDesc.message: Turn off for a much smaller file, but pictures come out blank

optFontsDesc.message: Turn off and letter shapes may shift, changing where lines break

optFramesDesc.message: Needed for pages that load their body in a separate frame

optScrollDesc.message: Turn off and the saved file contains no scripts at all

optScrollOff.message: Freeze already removes every script, so this has no effect

optPinDesc.message: Locks tables and images to their original size. Turn off and the layout may shift

savedStats.message: Kept $KEPT$ visible elements, emptied $HIDDEN$ hidden ones.

whereSaved.message: It's in your Downloads folder. Press $KEY$ to open it.

errNoResponse.message: The page changed. Reload it ($KEY$) and try again.

errChromePage.message: This is a screen Chrome draws itself, so it can't be saved.

errStale.message: The extension was updated. Please reload the page.

errUnknown.message: Something went wrong while saving. Reload the page and try again.
